replit.md.content:
# replit.md

## Overview

This is "ペア育" (Pair-iku), a Japanese co-parenting web app produced by 産前産後ケアホテル ぶどうの木 (prenatal/postnatal care hotel "Budou no Ki"). Parents (パパ/ママ) collaboratively log baby care activities like feeding (ミルク), diaper changes (おむつ), sleep (ねんね), and emergency calls (SOS/泣き止みレスキュー). The app features a points/gamification system where caregivers earn points for logging activities (with bonus points for late-night logs between midnight and 5am). It includes AI characters — 助産師 みおさん (warm, polite hospitality tone) and タカ先生 (energetic, supportive) — that provide encouraging messages. Families share a family ID to sync data between parents. The design uses an elegant grape purple (#805AAA) and natural green color scheme reflecting the "ぶどうの木" brand, with 24px+ rounded corners, NO emojis in UI (except grandfathered action dialog icons), and Lucide React icons exclusively.

## User Preferences

Preferred communication style: Simple, everyday language.

## System Architecture

### Frontend
- **Framework**: React 18 with TypeScript, bundled by Vite
- **Routing**: Wouter (lightweight client-side router) with pages: Home (`/`), Settings (`/settings`), Calendar (`/calendar`), Album (`/album`), Shop (`/shop`), Rescue (`/rescue`), Sleep Training (`/sleep-training`), and a 404 page
- **State Management**: TanStack React Query for server state with polling (logs refetch every 3s, settings every 5s)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui component library (new-york style). Custom color theme with Grape Purple (#805AAA) as primary and natural green accents. Uses 24px+ rounded corners throughout for a soft, friendly feel.
- **Fonts**: M PLUS Rounded 1c (Japanese display font) and Nunito (body text)
- **Animations**: Framer Motion for button interactions, page transitions, and micro-interactions
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **UI Components**: Full shadcn/ui component library installed at `client/src/components/ui/`
- **Path aliases**: `@/` maps to `client/src/`, `@shared/` maps to `shared/`

### Backend
- **Framework**: Express 5 on Node.js with TypeScript (runs via tsx)
- **API Design**: REST API with centralized route definitions in `shared/routes.ts`. Routes use Zod schemas for input validation.
- **API Endpoints**:
  - `GET /api/logs/:familyId` — List all logs for a family
  - `POST /api/logs` — Create a new care log entry
  - `GET /api/settings/:familyId` — Get family settings
  - `POST /api/settings` — Update family settings
  - `GET /api/events/:familyId` — List all events for a family
  - `POST /api/events` — Create a new event
  - `POST /api/events/:id` — Update an event
  - `POST /api/events/:id/complete` — Mark event complete (creates log + 10pt)
  - `DELETE /api/events/:id` — Delete an event
  - `GET /api/coupons/:familyId` — List coupons (seeds defaults on first access)
  - `POST /api/coupons` — Create a custom coupon
  - `DELETE /api/coupons/:id` — Delete a custom coupon
  - `POST /api/coupons/exchange` — Exchange points for a coupon (server-validated cost)
  - `GET /api/user-coupons/:familyId` — List user's exchanged coupons
  - `POST /api/user-coupons/:id/redeem` — Mark coupon as used, notify partner
  - `GET /api/notifications/:familyId/:targetUser` — List notifications
  - `POST /api/notifications/:id/read` — Mark notification as read
  - `GET /api/skills/:familyId` — List skill completions
  - `POST /api/skills/complete` — Mark a skill as completed
  - `POST /api/skills/uncomplete` — Remove a skill completion
- **Development**: Vite dev server runs as middleware on the Express server with HMR
- **Production**: Client built to `dist/public`, server bundled with esbuild to `dist/index.cjs`

### Data Storage
- **Database**: PostgreSQL via `DATABASE_URL` environment variable
- **ORM**: Drizzle ORM with `drizzle-zod` for schema-to-Zod integration
- **Schema** (defined in `shared/schema.ts`):
  - `logs` table: id, familyId, userId (papa/mama), type (milk/diaper/sleep/sos/event_done/temp/symptom/milestone), points, message, subType, foodItems, foodAmount, isNewFood, imageUrl, poopColor, poopConsistency, bodyTemperature, symptoms, symptomNote, breastLeftMin, breastRightMin, isExpressed, expressedMl, formulaMl, createdAt
  - `settings` table: id, familyId (unique), babyName, babyBirthday, specialTrick, currentCaregiver
  - `events` table: id, familyId, title, date, time, assignee (パパ/ママ/未定), completed, completedBy, points, memo, createdAt
  - `coupons` table: id, familyId, title, cost, isCustom, createdBy, createdAt
  - `user_coupons` table: id, familyId, couponId, couponTitle, cost, ownerId, status (owned/used), usedAt, createdAt
  - `notifications` table: id, familyId, targetUser, message, type, read, createdAt
  - `sleep_checklist` table: id, familyId, date, darkness, temperature, safety, whiteNoise, createdAt
  - `sleep_routines` table: id, familyId, title, assignee, sortOrder, createdAt
  - `sleep_routine_logs` table: id, familyId, routineId, date, completedBy, completedAt
  - `skill_completions` table: id, familyId, userId, skillId, completedAt
  - `feedbacks` table: id, familyId, userId, message, createdAt
- **Migrations**: Drizzle Kit with `db:push` command for schema synchronization
- **Storage Layer**: `server/storage.ts` implements `IStorage` interface with `DatabaseStorage` class using Drizzle queries

### Shared Code
- `shared/schema.ts` — Database schema, Zod validation schemas, and TypeScript types shared between client and server
- `shared/routes.ts` — API route definitions with paths, methods, input schemas, and a `buildUrl` helper for parameterized routes

### Key Business Logic
- Points system: 10 points per log, 20 points for late-night logs (0:00–5:00), 30 points for routine completion (3x team bonus)
- Sleep training: Environment checklist (4 items per day), customizable routine steps with co-op tracking, night cry coaching timer with AI phases
- Family ID stored in localStorage for multi-family support
- Default settings auto-created when a family is first accessed
- User type (papa/mama) stored in localStorage
- Onboarding flow: First-time users see welcome screen → baby info → role selection, generates unique familyId
- Pairing: Partners share familyId code to sync data; settings page has copy + join code input
- Install guide: Settings page shows instructions for adding to home screen (iOS Safari / Android Chrome)
- Feedback: Users can send improvement suggestions from settings, saved to feedbacks table

## External Dependencies

- **PostgreSQL**: Required database, connected via `DATABASE_URL` environment variable. Uses `pg` (node-postgres) driver with connection pooling.
- **Google Fonts**: M PLUS Rounded 1c and Nunito loaded via CDN
- **No authentication system**: Family ID acts as a simple shared key (stored in localStorage)
- **No external API integrations**: The AI midwife character (みおさん) currently uses hardcoded messages, not an actual AI service

import * as React from "react"
import * as ScrollAreaPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-scroll-area"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const ScrollArea = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("relative overflow-hidden", className)}
    {...props}
  >
    <ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport className="h-full w-full rounded-[inherit]">
      {children}
    </ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport>
    <ScrollBar />
    <ScrollAreaPrimitive.Corner />
  </ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root>
))
ScrollArea.displayName = ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root.displayName

const ScrollBar = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar>
>(({ className, orientation = "vertical", ...props }, ref) => (
  <ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar
    ref={ref}
    orientation={orientation}
    className={cn(
      "flex touch-none select-none transition-colors",
      orientation === "vertical" &&
        "h-full w-2.5 border-l border-l-transparent p-[1px]",
      orientation === "horizontal" &&
        "h-2.5 flex-col border-t border-t-transparent p-[1px]",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  >
    <ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaThumb className="relative flex-1 rounded-full bg-border" />
  </ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar>
))
ScrollBar.displayName = ScrollAreaPrimitive.ScrollAreaScrollbar.displayName

export { ScrollArea, ScrollBar }
